subject: Conflict between Foundation Plan S-101 and Structural Detail 3/S502 over the cast-in

messages.text: The cast-in anchor bolt group location shown in Foundation Plan S-101 at Gridline B/2 conflicts with the mechanical ductwork and architectural ceiling framing routing shown in Structural Detail 3/S502. This needs immediate attention -- please prioritize a response. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is holding up steel fabrication release. We need this resolved before the next steel erection mobilization.

Revise the cast-in anchor bolt group per Structural Detail 3/S502; coordinate final dimensions with the affected trades before fabrication. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is holding up steel fabrication release.
